full_catalog_execution.bands: Equal item-count quartiles by training event count; ascending ID ties

sampled_execution.risk_formula: zscore(base candidate scores) + gamma * zscore(log1p(pathway mature successes) - risk * log1p(pathway mature nonprogressions))
sampled_execution.profile_rule: Q95-eligible corrected training attempts; profiles use Q90 labels
sampled_execution.normalization: Sampled score z-scores are within the fixed 1000-item candidate set; full-catalog score normalization differs

prediction_loss_comparison.interpretation: Negative means lower prediction loss; exploratory pointwise interval; not recommendation improvement
Negative means lower prediction loss; exploratory pointwise interval; not recommendation improvement

interpretation_limits.uncertainty: Paired user bootstrap, 5000 replicates, seed 20261020; report pointwise 95% intervals as pointwise rather than simultaneous
interpretation_limits.multiplicity: For the five primary differences also report Bonferroni simultaneous bootstrap intervals at 99% each, targeting a 95% family confidence level; bootstrap coverage remains approximate
interpretation_limits.secondary: Sampled metrics, auxiliary BIM controls, coverage, exposure, and subgroups are exploratory; label intervals accordingly
interpretation_limits.repeated_users: Do not treat repeated cases or folds from the same user as independent observations when pooling
interpretation_limits.selection_limit: Intervals are conditional on recorded settings and observed users; multiplicity adjustment does not remove research-selection bias from previously inspected outcomes
interpretation_limits.equivalence: Failure to exclude zero is not equivalence; no equivalence or noninferiority claim without a justified margin
interpretation_limits.operational_effect: No validated operational threshold exists; report absolute and relative effects without claiming practical benefit from statistical significance alone
